notes.title: Pecaminosa: A Deadly Hand to reach Steam this Summer
notes.content:
Hello, detectives:

This is a happy day for Cereal Games, as we’re finally able to reveal the surprise we kept secret all over the last months. This Summer, our project will rise from its ashes in the form of Pecaminosa: A Deadly Hand, a new edition published by 2Awesome Games. This version will feature the original game plus La Soirée, an epilogue chapter that completes John’s partner’s last case and deepens into the mystery of his vanishing. It will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and 5, and Xbox Series X|S this Summer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1366770/Pecaminosa__A_Pixel_Noir_Game/

To celebrate this special announcement, we released a new trailer that condenses the best of this original noir adventure. Get ready, once again or for the first time, to melt into the dark side of Pecaminosa, a city where vice, crime, and corruption are the daily bread.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cubpN7wYD1k][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/8be2cba3bd840f2db85cb7f2063bbc1a13c7c1ce.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]First-timer? Let us tell you about Pecaminosa…[/h3]
Take part in a dark and criminal world that will appeal to your most basic instincts at every step, just like in your favorite noir movies. Push your moral limits to the rhythm of jazz and find out how far you are willing to go to complete your mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/217376106061b39c7d136a61fdd82fe92afa0173.png[/img]

Bet hard, drink till collapse, surrender to pleasure, become friends with the scum, bribe the good guys… Imagination is the limit, but be careful if you don't want to end with a bullet in your head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/3fc26721902c3b33d40cb850c2546fa73b4f1e40.png[/img]

Distribute your experience points into four different parameters (Luck, Intelligence, Force and Endurance) and choose your equipment according to your custom build. Plus, you’ll be able to customize your character’s appearance — classy guys have bigger chances to win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/55530fb05b66e00f3c9d83c49a43d999e957dbf0.png[/img]

Besides taking part in an intense and dashing narrative, you also get to fight against big, bad, bosses. Keep an eye on their moves or you’ll soon be sleeping with the fishes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/3a7287cd317928c2300ec4ede762347cff134b35.png[/img]

For those who owned the game on Nintendo Switch, we agreed to give you a copy of Pecaminosa: A Deadly Hand as soon as it becomes available. As for Steam, we’ll update the original build and those who purchased it will receive the update automatically. We couldn’t think of a better way to make you part of this new journey, one that makes us feel happy and hopeful.

Last but not least, we’d like to ask a little favor. We’ve been invisible for too long, so help us tell everyone that Pecaminosa is more alive than ever. Wishlist Pecaminosa: A Deadly Hand, tell your friends about it, share the new trailer, and leave a support message whenever you can — every little bit counts!

[url=https://discord.gg/hMCheNb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/4dad25afadc2ab9d4e7a77a90f6d0df0461d6d7c.gif[/img][/url]

See you in our next update,
Cereal Games

notes.title: Game discount and some more SURPRISES!!!
notes.content:
Esteemed detectives,

It's with great pleasure that we announce that [b]Pecaminosa - La Soirée[/b] is now available on Steam and that the [b]entire game can now be purchased at a 15% discount.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/f2ce8d202ca9175bf1cf99e934a594ae2d81b96a.gif[/img]


It's important to note that this [b]free update is now available for all players[/b]. To anyone more off-the-grid not really following our news (it's ok, no hard feelings...),[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1669460/Pecaminosa__La_Soire_The_Epilogue/] La Soirée is the natural conclusion of the main game's story.[/url]


This means, [spoiler] now that you've already kicked the Devil's ass [/spoiler], you can now go back to searching for your trusty old friend, Sully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/bc905b0319f6b2c8aa756972499097b7703e7be3.gif[/img]

[h1]Updates[/h1]


We've decided to add new features to the game: there are [b]new areas to explore, new characters[/b] to interact with, bet on [b]slot machines[/b], try your hand at [b]poker[/b], face a [b]new boss[/b] and decide how the story ends because this additional chapter holds [b]different endings[/b] to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/3f650feef4a3470e6fc520e0a7fc3f93cdbc6707.gif[/img]

[h1]Now available in Portuguese[/h1]

Another update we've done at the request of many families.: Pecaminosa is now available in Camões' and luso-descendant John Souza's language and you will be finally allowed to speak in portuguese if you so desire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/5d3c9d5159d8a0539bca23be2fb5878e018f25bd.gif[/img]

[b]P.S - Sully is in dire straits... Hurry up![/b]

notes.title: La Soirée: Pecaminosa's free title update is coming soon
notes.content:
Detective, Detective…

 
No question shall remain unanswered. La Soirée, that is the name of the additional chapter, of the epilogue where every loose end of the story will be tied up...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/b591fe6a8d0c4a2e3ecc78813263b8199c7243c4.gif[/img]

… Actually, you will be the one to close and define its last chapter: you can remain a mess, reinforce your role as a useful idiot, or do the right thing. It’s up to you detective.

[h3]Important: All owners of Pecaminosa will be playing La Soirée as a free title update![/h3]

This game's extension [b]has new areas in store for you[/b], a [b]new boss,[/b] more minigames [b](Poker and Slot Machines)[/b] and answers for your questions. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1669460/Pecaminosa__La_Soire_The_Epilogue/

Hurry up,

Sully might not have much time.

P.S - We’ll let you know when La Soirée will be finally available...Don't worry!

notes.title: Pecaminosa now available for MacOS and Linux
notes.content:
Hello detectives,


The best part of the party is waiting for it and now you can enjoy the fact of being able to play Pecaminosa – A Pixel Noir Game on MacOS or Linux.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39171306/7cd9a6a13ffc3e07cbb672e6ecf9073886a7ddea.gif[/img] 
 

Are you sad you got the game after the folks playing on Windows and Nintendo Switch? Don’t be; the game you’ll receive will include all updates and quality of life improvements made since we launched our game on the 27th of May.

 

Enjoy it and don’t forget to leave a review, detective. Let us know your thoughts.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Bug fixes and balance patches

tags.balance_change: Removed the out of stamina walk speed penalty;
John Souza’s walk speed has been increased;

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't detect the controller the first time you played the game;
Fixed a bug where sometimes you could win or lose multiple times at once by repeatedly pressing the “Stand” button at blackjack;
Fixed a bug where sometimes you would lose some perk points;
Fixed a bug where you could get stuck on the third stage of Rourke if you dashed into the planks at the right time;
Fixed a bug where Amuso’s zodiac puzzle would break if the player managed to activate 4 of the symbols fast enough;
Fixed a bug where you couldn't take screenshots in the game with Steam Overlay;
Fixed a bug where you could crash the game if you changed from mouse to controller and then went to the map;
Fixed a bug where you could crash the game if you "talked" with the fridge in the right circumstances;
